description: Add flow-regime interactions: log-aging x no_flow (pre-coagulated quiescent smoke) and Kapton/Teflon x no_flow

model.formula: size_j = ridge(material one-hot + log1p(aging)/7 + no_flow + 5(Rt/R0-1.35) + log1p(aging)/7*no_flow + small_particle_material*no_flow); logit P_j = same design, L2 logistic (C=1)
model.notes: Linear physics-motivated design; ridge alpha=1 with unpenalized intercept.
